delivery_methodology: The project will be executed using an AI-enabled agile approach characterized by short, time-boxed iterations with regular demonstrations and continuous client feedback. This iterative process allows for incremental delivery of features, ensuring alignment with client expectations and timely adjustments to scope as needed. Quality assurance is integrated throughout the cycle with automated testing and peer reviews.

AI tools assist by drafting documentation, generating code snippets, and automating routine tasks, while human experts review, refine, and approve all outputs to maintain quality and relevance. This collaboration between AI and people accelerates delivery without compromising accuracy or client control, fostering transparency and responsiveness throughout the project lifecycle.
executive_summary: Kalinaw Trading Corporation seeks to enhance its human resource management through a comprehensive Human Resource Information System (HRIS) that streamlines employee data, leave management, attendance, and reporting. This initiative is critical to improving operational efficiency, data accuracy, and employee self-service capabilities across the organization.

Exist Software Labs proposes a cloud-deployed microservices solution built on a robust Java/Spring Boot backend with a React frontend and PostgreSQL database. The system will be delivered using an AI-enabled agile methodology, ensuring iterative development with continuous client feedback. Upon completion, Kalinaw Trading Corporation will have a scalable, secure, and user-friendly HRIS tailored to its operational needs.
proposed_solution: The proposed HRIS solution integrates key capabilities including employee information management, leave and attendance tracking, payroll interfacing, and comprehensive reporting. It supports multiple user roles such as employees, HR staff, approvers, and management, facilitating seamless workflows from data entry to approvals and reporting. Employees can self-manage their profiles and requests, while HR staff maintain organizational data and oversee approvals, ensuring alignment with company policies.

This solution aligns with Kalinaw Trading Corporation’s operational processes by automating routine tasks, enhancing data visibility through dashboards and reports, and supporting compliance with leave and attendance policies. The system’s modular design allows for future enhancements and integration with existing payroll systems, delivering the benefits of improved accuracy, efficiency, and user satisfaction without overpromising beyond the defined scope.
technical_architecture: The HRIS is architected as a cloud-hosted microservices platform leveraging Java and Spring Boot for backend services, React for the user interface, and PostgreSQL for data persistence. The architecture includes distinct layers for presentation, business logic, and data access, ensuring separation of concerns and maintainability. Integration with external payroll systems is handled via secure APIs, with audit trails and notifications embedded throughout the system.

The cloud deployment supports scalability to handle up to 300 concurrent users with high availability and performance targets. Role-based access control and comprehensive audit logging ensure security and compliance. This architecture is well-suited to the client’s requirements for a reliable, scalable, and secure HRIS that supports complex workflows and data management needs.
warranty_support: The solution includes a warranty period during which any defects or issues identified will be promptly addressed and corrected at no additional cost. Defects can be reported through a defined support channel, and the warranty covers functional and performance aspects as specified in the project scope.

Issues outside the warranty scope, such as enhancements or changes beyond the agreed requirements, will be handled through separate support agreements. This approach ensures that Kalinaw Trading Corporation receives reliable post-deployment support while maintaining clarity on the boundaries of warranty coverage.
